s.en: display lines beginning with a given string

o.en: Use normal dictionary character set and order, i.e., only blanks and alphanumeric characters are compared. This is on by default if no file is specified. Note that blanks have been added to dictionary character set for compatibility with sort -d command since version 2.28.
Ignore the case of alphabetic characters. This is on by default if no file is specified.
Specify a string termination character, i.e., only the characters in string up to and including the first occurrence of character are compared.
